shortDescription: This module manages clone and thinclone of volume and volumegroup

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname, management IP or partition IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: draftpartition
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the draft partition to be assigned to the volume group.

options.name: fromsourcevolumes
options.description: Specifies colon-separated list of the parent volumes name or UID. The parameters I(fromsourcevolumes) is mandatory for clone volumes and optional for clone volume groups while creating clone.

options.name: ignoreuserfcmaps
options.description: Indicates that snapshots can be created with the scheduler or with the addsnapshot command, if any volumes in the volume group are used as a source volume in legacy FlashCopy mapping.

options.name: iogrp
options.description: Specifies the name of the I/O group for the new clone.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies a name for the new clone.

options.name: ownershipgroup
options.description: Specifies the name of the ownership group to which the object is being added.

options.name: partition
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the storage partition to associate with the volume group.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: pool
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the storage pool to use while creating the clone. The parameters I(pool) is mandatory for clone volumes and optional for clone volume groups while creating clone.

options.name: preferrednode
options.description: Specifies the preferred node that is used to access the volume.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the snapshot that is used to create the clone. The parameters I(fromsourcevolumes) is mandatory for creating clone.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) the clone object.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies the type of clone to create. Volume can be thinclone or clone type.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification.

options.name: volumegroup
options.description: Specifies the name or UUID of the volumegroup to which the clone is to be added. When logging in via partition IP, the I(volumegroup) parameter is required to create a volume clone.
